Pattern.Intent: Error-path scenario: focused assertions via `assert.rejects()` + `assert.match()` on a stable message fragment; no `try/catch + flag` antipatterns.
Pattern.Why: Combined TRIGGER+ASSERT via `assert.rejects` is intentional — forced phase split would yield an empty TRIGGER. The single `rejects` call needs no anchor; SETUP has multiple lines + interception policy → anchored.
